title: 부서진 하늘
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE finished story-stage landscape illustration, without any title or lettering. Opaque wide 16:9 at the largest available landscape resolution, intended for downscaling to 640x360 and display at 360-480px width. Reference 1 is the game's painted pixel-art style anchor; reference 2 is its story painting style; reference 3 is this realm's palette, architecture and landmarks. All are reference inputs, not edit targets. Match the crisp visible painted pixel clusters and stepped silhouettes, rich but controlled colour, layered fantasy depth; no photographic or smooth 3D rendering. Cohesive nine-picture set rules: wide level establishing view, one dominant landmark centred horizontally in the MIDDLE THIRD, skyline/horizon around 70-74% image height in the LOWER THIRD, key environmental light from UPPER LEFT, midtone readability with dark blue-violet shadows, moderate saturation and contrast comparable to the other realms. Simple large shapes readable in a thumbnail. The outermost 3% on every side must be low-detail calm scenery safe for an 8px frame overlap, but DO NOT draw a frame. Keep the entire landmark in view. No people, human faces, humanoid figures, statues, letters, text-like decoration, glyphs, runes, numerals, logo, watermark, UI, borders or frames. No text anywhere. Stage 1, take A. A HUMAN TOWN of clustered steep timber-and-slate rooftops at DUSK. The central single landmark is a compact tall gabled town hall rising from the lower-third roofline, with blue-grey slate roofs, amber windows and warm ochre stone inspired by reference 3. High above it the indigo-and-copper dusk sky is visibly SPLIT by several irregular branching glowing pink-gold cracks, clearly a fissured sky rather than ordinary lightning. Three faraway realm islands drift across the distant sky, small restrained silhouettes with floating rock undersides. Take A composition: direct panoramic view across a shallow roof valley toward the town hall; the widest crack forms a branching arch above the middle landmark, no giant moon. Upper-left sunset illuminates the left roof planes. Keep dwellings simple and absent of flags, signs, clock faces and inhabitants.
